Native identity: a vivid red, multi-lobed clover-shaped blob (four to five rounded lobes forming the crown) with darker maroon seed-like inclusions clustered near the centre and a glossy highlight upper-left.

prompt_fields.subject: One red jelly: a stationary mound whose crown is broken into four or five distinct rounded lobes meeting at the centre, like a clover or a segmented berry, rather than one continuous dome. Several small darker maroon seed-like inclusions are visible clustered near the centre just under the glossy surface, thinning out toward the lobe edges. One broad soft highlight sits across the upper-left lobes consistent with the lighting.
prompt_fields.contrast: Five other jellies already exist in this family and must not be told apart by hue alone. Give red jelly a distinct multi-lobed clover silhouette (four or five rounded lobes meeting at a shared centre) unlike green jelly's single rippled dome, black jelly's sagging flat tar mound, white jelly's faceted crystalline planes and yellow jelly's small blister bumps; the lobes must be large, clearly separated shapes, not a texture. Value: a saturated warm mid-to-bright red body, distinct from all five siblings' value/hue, with the darker maroon centre inclusions as a second, unique internal-marking cue (unlike green's scattered debris specks, yellow's streak-lines, or white/black's plain surfaces). This is also the sibling that must read apart from blue jelly in the same handoff: red is lobed and warm, blue is a single smooth swirled dome and cool.
prompt_fields.composition: One entire stationary mound on one disc, steep overhead three-quarter view, centred with no facing direction (this creature never moves). The body sits low and wide, its base spreading unevenly where it meets the disc; every lobe, facet or inclusion stays inside the disc with the outer sixth of the disc radius left as bare base plate. Keep the tallest lobe out of the upper-right rank corner and the upper-left interaction corner. No second creature, no puddle trail, no scenery.
prompt_fields.palette: Saturated red with a paler warm-pink lit crown on the upper-left lobes, small dark maroon-brown inclusions near the centre, deep brick-red base shadow between the lobes. No glow, no fire effect, no ground stain.
